question: What act is declared, and what item is named in that declaration addressed to the beloved?
premises: An act in fused form is named.
A soft seat is named as the item.
The declaration is addressed to the beloved.
inference: Sending to its own place is declared to be the soft seat, O beloved.
uncertainties: Ritual function of sending to its own place not specified by this verse alone
plain_english: Sending to its own place is declared to be the soft seat, O beloved.
